purpose: Teach: 淡い/申す/かけがえ/えらく/おぼえ/おろか/無邪気/あきれ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、夕焼けが淡い色に染まったわね
lines.en: Sho, look how soft the sunset is — the sky's painted in such gentle colors.
lines.style: Warm, inviting observation. Gentle cadence that asks him to pause and notice with her. Slightly wistful, the tone of someone savoring a small moment before it passes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「いただきます」と申す前から食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I ate some before I even said itadakimasu with Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet confession with a small undertone of pride. Not boastful — more like he's testing whether this matters as much as he worried it might. Slight uptick at the end, seeking her response.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは、かけがえのない方ね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is someone truly irreplaceable.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself at first. Then settling into certainty. Not lecturing — sharing something she knows to be true, and wants him to know it too. Slight pause before the last word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがえらくお仕事頑張ってらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was working really, really hard today.
lines.style: Small, thoughtful observation. Matter-of-fact but tinged with something like protectiveness or quiet admiration. He's noticed something and is reporting it seriously, the way he sees things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの言葉をおぼえておきましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you should hold onto what your grandfather said, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but purposeful. The voice of someone passing something down without making it heavy. Kind direction — not command. Warm attention on his name at the opening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、おろかな事を言って、お祖父ちゃんに笑われたよ
lines.en: Mom, I said something silly and Grandpa laughed at me.
lines.style: Dry, small amusement beneath a surface of mock-embarrassment. He's not wounded — more like he's noticing the humor in himself. Deadpan delivery with an undertone of acceptance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、翔くんの無邪気な笑顔、最高ね
lines.en: Sho, that innocent smile of yours — there's nothing better than it.
lines.style: Warm praise delivered without performance. Direct, sincere. She means exactly what she's saying. Slight breath of affection on 'smile,' landing firmly on the last word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、ぼくのいたずらにあきれてらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad looked kind of stunned by my antics.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware comment with a barely-suppressed grin underneath. The tone of a kid who knows what he did was funny and is still turning it over in his mind. Small, genuine amusement.
